verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing docs confirm automated Smart Retries to recover failed payments, which is the core of dunning automation, but the evidence pack lacks any mention of branded dunning emails, in-app banners, configurable grace periods, or explicit final-state rules (cancel vs. mark-unpaid) that the story requires. missing for 10: branded email templates, in-app banner configuration, grace period settings, explicit cancel-vs-unpaid final state rules.
